posts.author: enelay
posts.text: Company has confirmed NSE has listed their shares under the well established Permitted to Trade route where stocks listed on one exchange only can be offered on the other exchange without going through a formal listing process. Some companies choose to still go ahead with a “full” listing while others choose to continue in PTT. One article showed data that stocks listed on NSE via this route see +100% increase in trading volume within a year. This is great news and IMO a major trigger for the stock. bseindia.com 5ada2760-1651-42aa-b673-d50bf7c0d398.pdf
